title: Accurate or Precise? Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
A dart player who hits the same spot every time, far from the bullseye. Diya's two kitchen scales: one gives the same wrong reading again and again, the other jumps around the true value. Which is better? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (Chapter 1, Units and Measurement; accuracy and precision are in the JEE Main and NEET syllabus) we learn the two words physicists never mix up.

On a live measuring bench each reading drops onto a number line and a graph while the readout tracks the mean, the gap from the true value (accuracy) and the spread (precision). We see why a steady error is systematic, why a finer instrument is more precise but not always more accurate, and the four-target picture. Then a worked example, the exam trap, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.
